author: cc-pulseline
description: Bespoke palette tuned for peripheral statusline reading. Three intent layers: substrate (chrome), datum (values), pulse (movement). Aurora gradient teal → coral.

intent_layers.substrate: Frame, separators, section breaks — never read, only seen.
intent_layers.datum: Numbers, names, token counts — high-contrast pearl on dark / charcoal on light.
intent_layers.pulse: Anything that moves — sparklines, gauges, active rows. 3-stop gradient cool→mid→warm.

design_notes.philosophy: Peripheral statusline reading. Substrate disappears, datum jumps, pulse animates. Aurora gradient is the only place colour 'moves'.
design_notes.active_collapsed: active_cyan / active_purple / active_teal all collapsed to aurora_mid (80). Differentiation by icon shape, not hue. Reduces colour count from 5 active variants to 1.
design_notes.alert_calmed: alert_orange uses 178 (vs tokyo-night's 214) — Aurora is calmer. alert_magenta is 217 rose, not the hard 201.
design_notes.aurora_gradient_invariant: aurora_low/mid/high are theme-invariant (same dark + light codes). They are brand pigment, not mode-aware chrome. Confirmed legible on light backgrounds via 73/80/209 contrast check.
